inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 22nd August, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) issued an alert over the possibility of convective cloud formation accompanied by light to moderate rainfall, which may become heavy at times. The alert is in effect from 13:30 on Saturday until 21:00 the same day. The NCM said the weather conditions are expected to affect some eastern, southern and western areas, extending to parts of the country's interior.

requested_area.areaDesc: Eastern, southern and western areas (demo zone)

fields.description: NCM alert: convective clouds may bring light to moderate rain, heavy at times, to some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior. In effect Saturday 13:30 to 21:00.
fields.headline: NCM alert: possible rain, heavy at times, Saturday 13:30 to 21:00
fields.instruction: Take care if you are outdoors or driving while it rains. Follow official updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
fields.note_for_reviewer: The source gives no specific protective actions, so the instruction is generic. The source also gives times without a time zone (assumed local) and names only 'Saturday'; the WAM article date of 2026-08-22 is a Saturday.

payload.summary: The alert matches the verified NCM bulletin. The hazard is the same: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, heavy at times. The time window is the same: Saturday 13:30 to 21:00. The areas are the same: some eastern, southern and western areas plus parts of the interior. Certainty 'Possible' reflects the bulletin's 'possibility' wording, and Moderate/Expected does not overstate it. No unverified input is used.

no_basis.concern: The headline credits the alert to 'NCM', but the registered sender is the demo national authority. The UAE portal's list of entities authorised to send warnings does not include the meteorological centre. People may want to confirm that attributing the alert to NCM is intended and that the real issuer is the one this sender stands in for.
no_basis.searched_for: A clause stating whether a meteorological service may be named as the issuer in a headline sent under another authority's sender identity, or whether NCM is an authorised alerting entity in the UAE.

No higher-authority alerts are active that it could overreach.

no_basis.concern: No UAE or 3GPP clause shown requires the hazard and the action to appear on the first cell broadcast page specifically. The only support for including an action at all is the FCC (US) clause.

objections.fix: Add a short protective action in both languages and put the hazard and action first, ahead of the area and time. For example, in English: "NCM: heavy rain risk. Avoid valleys and flood areas, drive with care." Give an Arabic equivalent with the hazard and action inside the first 41 characters as far as possible, then the areas and times. Keep each language within 15 pages.
objections.issue: Neither the English nor the Arabic phone text contains any protective action telling the public what to do. Only the hazard and the validity time are given. The first page therefore cannot carry the action. In Arabic, the 41-character first page also cuts off mid-word before the hazard is fully stated.

The hazard is the same: rain from convective clouds (السحب الركامية), light to moderate and heavy at times.
